title: Coherent proper/open interchange data on a category of schemes
statement:
Let $A$ be a collection of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. A proper/open calculus on $A$ consists of a category $D_X$ for each $X$ in $A$, functors $P_p:D_X\to D_Y$ for proper maps [def-weil-proper-morphism] $p:X\to Y$ between its schemes, and functors $J_j:D_U\to D_X$ for quasi-compact open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] (the open immersions among finite-type arrows) $j:U\to X$. It has identity isomorphisms $P_{id_X}\simeq id$ and $J_{id_X}\simeq id$, and natural composition isomorphisms $P_qP_p\simeq P_{qp}$ and $J_kJ_j\simeq J_{kj}$ satisfying the associative and left and right unit equations. For every commutative square $pk=ir$ with quasi-compact open horizontal maps $k,i$ and proper vertical maps $r,p$, it specifies a natural isomorphism $\gamma_Q:J_iP_r\simeq P_pJ_k$. The vertical paste is $(P_{p_2}\gamma_{Q_1})(\gamma_{Q_2}P_{r_1})$ and the horizontal paste is $(\gamma_{Q_2}J_k)(J_j\gamma_{Q_1})$, with the proper/open compositors inserted. If both vertical, respectively both horizontal, arrows are identities, gamma is the identity after those identity identifications.

For a compactification $c=(j,p)$, put $H_c=P_pJ_j$. For a refinement $v:d\to c$, its comparison $\rho_v:H_c\simeq H_d$ inserts the proper identity isomorphism, applies gamma to $v j_d=j_c id_X$, then applies the proper compositor. For a common refinement $d\to c_1,c_2$, the comparison $H_{c_2}\simeq H_{c_1}$ is $\rho_{v_1}^{-1}\rho_{v_2}$. For a compatible binary tower as in [lem-cbc-compactifiable-compatible-tower], its composition isomorphism is the displayed proper/open gamma whiskered by the outside proper/open functors and followed by the open/proper compositors. A tower refinement is a triple of refinements of its compactifications of $f,g,gf$, commuting with both tower arrows, with no additional cartesianness assumption. The identity identification of $H_{(id_X,id_X)}$ uses the two identity isomorphisms.

The geometric-existence predicate on $A$ means: for every separated finite-type map [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] between its schemes, the compactifications with ambient scheme in $A$ are nonempty and cofiltered, meaning common refinements and equalizing refinements as in [lem-cbc-compactifiable-cofiltered]; given compactifications of $g$ and $gf$, compatible binary towers over the prescribed compactification of $g$, refining the one of $gf$, exist; any two binary towers in $A$ have a common refining tower; and three composable such maps have a compatible three-map staircase with all six ambient schemes in $A$. The binary cartesian squares and the three-map staircase squares are fibre-product squares [def-pc-fibre-product]. These are geometric hypotheses, not axioms asserting any coherence conclusion about rho or tower composition.
